hook: Cash FX Group promised 15% weekly returns, but the money vanished.

sections.voiceover: Cash FX Group promised 15% weekly returns, but the money vanished.

Regulators at the Commodity Futures Trading Commission filed a massive complaint. They claim Huascar Jose Lopez Castillo collected $950 million from unsuspecting investors. Where did that massive mountain of cash go?
Cash FX Group actually directed less than one percent of funds toward real forex trading.
This elaborate multilevel marketing scheme left investors holding the bag. Authorities in the United Kingdom, Ireland, and Australia had issued warnings years ago.
Check official regulator warnings before you hand over your hard-earned money.
